messages.opening.appointment.title: An Urgent Appointment
messages.opening.appointment.speaker: Royal Envoy
messages.opening.appointment.line_1: Hello. Are you the summoner who bid for the Demon King Countermeasure Project? The one whose bid was ultimately rejected?
messages.opening.appointment.line_2: Unfortunately, the hero was defeated by the Demon King in the north. The other winning projects have not fared much better. The Alchemical Mecha Project, for instance, has all but collapsed due to corruption.
messages.opening.appointment.line_3: His Majesty asks you to restart the Super Cool and Super Flashy Summoned Monsters Project. You are now our last hope.
messages.opening.appointment.line_4: This is the King's Special Writ. It permits you to travel freely through any city and receive assistance, provided that assistance does not involve resources.
messages.opening.appointment.line_5: As you know, taxes have troubled the kingdom for quite some time. The treasury deficit is rather severe at present.
messages.opening.appointment.line_6: Please sign this acknowledgment. And this one. Yes, turn it over; there is more on the back.
messages.opening.appointment.line_7: That concludes the handover. Please fill in this satisfaction survey.
messages.opening.appointment.line_8: As I am only a contracted messenger myself, I cannot accompany you. I wish you every success.
